layer.name: laneFrame
layer.note: v20 rulesets must not be changed by a single character; when the ruleset has no laneFrame layer, the laneFrame key must NOT appear in configureMatch args (stableStringify would serialize undefined as null and change every golden hash).

laneOffset.transform: swap top<->bot keys, mid unchanged, values unchanged

gankWeights.transform: swap top<->bot keys, mid unchanged, values unchanged

splitLane.transform: swap top<->bot value; mid and null unchanged

laneKeyedKnobs.rule: every lane-keyed knob field must be declared here (keys vs value); an undeclared lane-keyed field fails A2

inputs.note: 21 templates x every provided lanes.* Registry choice; total 186

A1.desc: per-seat read of laneOffset/gankWeights/splitLane-equality for top/mid/adc seats, both teams, under teamRelative

A2.desc: LANE_KEYED_KNOBS registry complete (resolved-knob scan + explicit declaration)

A3.desc: single conversion point; scan import identifiers with comments stripped
subConditions: single conversion point lives in the Director
the Director imports the lane mapping (worldLaneForSide/sideRelativeLane) only from gameData.js
the engine reads knobs only via the Director

pass: knobs("red") returns the SAME reference on every call, and the converted object is frozen
red identity never becomes null when it was non-null

blue===red same-object case is listed: legacy behaviour pinned (red takes blue identity under legacyMirror); unreachable via the assembler (two teams are cloned separately), only direct configureMatch callers can hit it

A4.desc: negative control: same inputs under legacyMirror must report mismatches
A4.pass: legacyMirror reports exactly 120 (any change in templates/choices must be explainable)

asymmetricTemplates.desc: the 8 of 21 templates whose top/bot read differently; only these may make red rows differ (C4)

behavioural.arms: each plan P is run twice: P as blue (opponent std), P as red (opponent std)
behavioural.layouts: each seed runs STANDARD and SWAPPED once each (forced layout)

seeds.reason: the proposal's example 6001-6100 overlaps draft §1.3 range 6001-7000 reserved for C8 family sampling, and 4601-5000 is reserved for Owner assignment; 9001-9100 is outside every registered range in the draft §1.3 table (ledger check done 2026-10-15 by the controller) and was never used by the tactic measurements (1-40, 1001-1400, 1401-1800, 2001-2060)

behavioural.seedNote: seed 9091 is used incidentally by two single-seed gates; this is not a range collision

statistics.effectSide: effect_side(s,L) = m(P on that side vs std) - m(std vs std control, same side, same s, L); m measured team-relative
statistics.D: D(s) = mean over the 2 layouts of [effect_red(s,L) - effect_blue(s,L)]
statistics.passB2B3: |z_diff| < 2 AND |mean(D)| <= 0.05 for share-type metrics (shares in [0,1]); for non-share metrics |mean(D)| <= 0.05 * |mean(effect_blue)| (5 % of the blue effect)
statistics.sameSign: sign(mean effect_blue) = sign(mean effect_red) for every plan x metric where |z| of the blue effect >= 2 (z of the effect vs control, same formula)
statistics.B1: per match: share of split ticks done by the side's own-lane seat >= 0.99 in EVERY match (deterministic)
statistics.negativeControl: under legacyMirror the same B1 check must FAIL for red on the top-split plan: legacy red own-lane share < 0.5 (falsifiable replacement of '~0')
statistics.fullN: full n mandatory; any reduced run is diagnostic only

n.b1MinimalAlternative: 5-10 matches per arm suffice for B1 only

behavioural.frame: all metrics in team-relative frame; difference-in-differences vs same-side control (not raw red-vs-blue)

B1.desc: share of lane-split ticks owned by the player whose team-relative lane = plan's lane
B1.pass: every match: own-lane seat share >= 0.99 (both teams)

B2.desc: gankShare.<lane> (team frame via execInTeamFrame helper) delta vs same-team control
B2.pass: see statistics: sameSign rule; |z_diff| < 2 AND |mean(D)| <= 0.05 (share metric)
B2.toleranceSource: TD-3A-23 §4-b, adopted by Owner D-1 = A (2026-10-15); 0.05 basis = control baseline gap 0.000/0.009 (§1.4-3)
B2.toleranceNote: residual world-order asymmetry was never measured; a failure is a STOP-for-Owner event, not a reason to change the tolerance

B3.pass: see statistics: sameSign rule; |z_diff| < 2 AND (share metric: |mean(D)| <= 0.05; non-share: |mean(D)| <= 0.05*|mean(effect_blue)|)
B3.toleranceSource: TD-3A-23 §4-b, adopted by Owner D-1 = A (2026-10-15)

behavioural.negativeControl: same design under laneFrame=legacyMirror: B1 must FAIL for red on the top-split plan (legacy red own-lane share < 0.5)
